About the Competition

MANTRASTRA is a three-round AI Engineering Competition designed to evaluate participants' ability to understand, debug, develop, and optimise software using AI tools. The competition focuses on AI-assisted software engineering, code comprehension, and agentic development.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to students of all academic years from all colleges and universities.
  • Team size: 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialisation and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
  • Each participant can register as a member of only one team.
  • Registration is free and can be completed on Unstop.

Competition Format

The competition will consist of three rounds:

Round 1: Build with AI

  • Interested students will have the opportunity to attend an offline workshop covering Prompt Engineering, Git & GitHub, and Agentic AI tools, followed by a quiz.
  • Students who do not opt for the workshop will directly participate in an online quiz conducted through Unstop.
  • The quiz will evaluate fundamental knowledge of AI, programming, software

HackZ’26 – National Level Hackathon

About HackZ’26

HackZ’26 is a national-level hackathon presented by the Computer Science and Engineering Association (CSEA), College of Engineering, Guindy (CEG), Anna University, in association with the Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) initiative of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.

Powered by Temenos, Supported by IBM, and Hosted on Unstop, HackZ’26 brings together engineering students to solve real-world challenges through technology and innovation.

The hackathon encourages collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and the development of unique, innovative, and industry-relevant solutions that can be scaled and implemented in the real world. Every proposed solution must incorporate security as an important component.

data.title: Bad Ideas Only
data.details:
About the Opportunity

Tired of trying to build the next unicorn startup?
Good. Welcome to Bad Ideas Only, hosted by Hoollow.
This is a satirical, 100% online pitch competition where your only goal is to invent the absolute worst, most over-engineered, and utterly useless tech product possible.
We don't want real solutions; we want chaotic system architectures, terrible business models, and AI-generated mockups for a problem that doesn't exist. No manual coding is required.
